00de2536d47e.en: First Subjugation Period (~5,000 to ~4,500 B.G.): with the Finaies out of the picture and the Lishies out of reach, their society flourished. Having modified Wingas into Big Wingas and Yabuca trees into Wood People and bent them to their will, they researched how to subjugate the other two races. Wingarest became the home of the Big Wingas. The Wood People were created by altering the souls of Yabuca trees, then confined to small forests across the Buhraies Plains, where they produced food and lumber in a controlled way. Their goal: subjugate and experiment on the Finaies in the north, and fix and terraform Hifuna.
00de2536d47e.t: Zaman Penaklukan Pertama (~5,000 hingga ~4,500 B.G.): dengan Finaies tiada lagi dan Lishies tidak dapat mencapai mereka, masyarakat mereka berkembang maju. Setelah mengubah Winga menjadi Big Winga dan pokok Yabuca menjadi Wood People dan menundukkan mereka mengikut kehendak, mereka menyelidik cara menakluki dua bangsa lain. Wingarest menjadi rumah Big Winga. Wood People dicipta dengan mengubah jiwa pokok Yabuca, kemudian dikurung di hutan-hutan kecil di seluruh Buhraies Plains, di mana mereka menghasilkan makanan dan kayu secara terkawal. Matlamat mereka: menakluki dan bereksperimen ke atas Finaies di utara, dan membaiki serta membentuk semula Hifuna.

01e35785d15a.en: The Buhraies decided to test everything they knew about subjugation on the Fuhraies, but it didn't work, and they fought. Or rather, the Fuhraies kept defending themselves from the Buhraies' weak attacks: being fleshy, the Buhraies weren't used to such cold weather and altitude. Negotiations never worked.
01e35785d15a.t: Buhraies memutuskan untuk menguji segala yang mereka tahu tentang penaklukan ke atas Fuhraies, tetapi ia tidak berkesan, dan mereka bertempur. Atau lebih tepat, Fuhraies terus mempertahankan diri daripada serangan lemah Buhraies: sebagai makhluk berdaging, Buhraies tidak biasa dengan cuaca dan altitud yang begitu sejuk. Rundingan tidak pernah berjaya.

01e61492a86b.en: Once a person's heart is replaced with a stone, they can only feel the emotion set in it. Most who tried it died, going berserk or taking their own lives, among other reasons. The few who could live with a stone became legends. The stone also seeps into the person's soul, corrupting it and causing many symptoms, including being impossible to revive.
01e61492a86b.t: Sebaik jantung seseorang diganti dengan batu, dia hanya boleh merasai emosi yang ditetapkan di dalamnya. Kebanyakan yang mencubanya mati, mengamuk atau membunuh diri, antara sebab lain. Segelintir yang boleh hidup dengan batu menjadi legenda. Batu itu juga meresap ke dalam jiwa orang itu, merosakkannya dan menyebabkan banyak gejala, termasuk mustahil dihidupkan semula.

027433560234.en: Mountain Overtake Period (~250 to ~270 A.G.): the Darfaries killed everyone, their history included. But Wozefaries and Sorefaries kept being born: their blood was tainted forever, and some Darfaries grew uneasy about killing their own babies for the sake of purity. That's when the first king, Gandew, established the Goodbye Cliff, from which every Wozefaries and Sorefaries was sent flying toward Flatland. Anyone who didn't accept it had to leave. With the ancient species kicked out, the Darfaries named the mountain Gandew after their first king, claiming it as their own.
027433560234.t: Zaman Pengambilalihan Gunung (~250 hingga ~270 A.G.): Darfaries membunuh semua orang, termasuk sejarah mereka. Tetapi Wozefaries dan Sorefaries terus dilahirkan: darah mereka tercemar selama-lamanya, dan sesetengah Darfaries menjadi tidak senang dengan membunuh bayi sendiri demi kesucian. Ketika itulah raja pertama, Gandew, mewujudkan Goodbye Cliff, dari situ setiap Wozefaries dan Sorefaries dilontar terbang ke arah Flatland. Sesiapa yang tidak menerimanya terpaksa pergi. Dengan spesies purba diusir, Darfaries menamakan gunung itu Gandew sempena raja pertama mereka, menuntutnya sebagai milik mereka.

02ff2cf75787.en: The Last Breath Time (~855 B.G. to ~380 A.G.)
02ff2cf75787.t: Masa Nafas Terakhir (~855 B.G. hingga ~380 A.G.)

043219ba4522.en: Lishies Subjugation Period (~4,500 to ~3,500 B.G.): they tried to subjugate the Lishies, but not only did it fail, it led the Lishies to discover how to get up onto the Buhraies Plains. The Lishies were hard to fight there, and the peaceful life on the plains was over: the Buhraies researched how to keep the Lishies at bay while skirmishing nearly every week. ~3,575 B.G.: the Lishies launched a war against the Buhraies, and both sides were decimated as the battle raged on.
043219ba4522.t: Zaman Penaklukan Lishies (~4,500 hingga ~3,500 B.G.): mereka cuba menakluki Lishies, tetapi bukan sahaja gagal, malah ia membawa Lishies menemui cara naik ke Buhraies Plains. Lishies sukar dilawan di sana, dan hidup aman di dataran itu berakhir: Buhraies menyelidik cara menghalang Lishies sambil bertempur kecil hampir setiap minggu. ~3,575 B.G.: Lishies melancarkan perang terhadap Buhraies, dan kedua-dua pihak musnah teruk semasa pertempuran berterusan.

0637cad88a3e.en: ~6,000 to ~5,000 B.G.: the Buhraies created their plains and separated themselves. The Lishies kept trying to reach them for payback, but without a Soul Energy interface, they couldn't.
0637cad88a3e.t: ~6,000 hingga ~5,000 B.G.: Buhraies mencipta dataran mereka dan memisahkan diri. Lishies terus cuba sampai kepada mereka untuk membalas dendam, tetapi tanpa antara muka Tenaga Jiwa, mereka tidak boleh.

09dc8c9ecef5.en: ~805 B.G.: a massive civil war broke out in Aldemeri, which burned for days, all instigated by humans. Some residents less inclined toward war fled to other cities (or to Flatland) and tried to stop another civil war. Several Lishies fled into what is now Flatland and made a pact with the Buhraies after a battle that thinned both sides.
09dc8c9ecef5.t: ~805 B.G.: perang saudara besar meletus di Aldemeri, yang terbakar berhari-hari, semuanya dihasut oleh manusia. Sesetengah penduduk yang kurang cenderung kepada perang lari ke bandar lain (atau ke Flatland) dan cuba menghentikan perang saudara lain. Beberapa Lishies lari ke tempat yang kini Flatland dan membuat perjanjian dengan Buhraies selepas pertempuran yang mengurangkan kedua-dua pihak.

130c253cf332.en: Embassies were founded soon after, and all ruins and major cities became Forway property. Sundeath tried to stay out of it all, but gave in under the sheer pressure from Forway; in exchange, it has Pharaohs as city leaders.
130c253cf332.t: Kedutaan diasaskan tidak lama kemudian, dan semua runtuhan dan bandar utama menjadi hak milik Forway. Sundeath cuba menjauhkan diri daripada semuanya, tetapi akur di bawah tekanan hebat daripada Forway; sebagai pertukaran, ia ada Firaun sebagai pemimpin bandar.

1392a673412a.en: Muscle Development Period (~15,000 to ~10,000 B.G.): the Finaies in the deep forest developed a taste for meat, and their bodies changed slightly, then a lot, as they became excellent hunters. The females preferred beefy, fleshy men, so they steered evolution toward losing the Finaies interface altogether. The Lishies became a new species.
1392a673412a.t: Zaman Perkembangan Otot (~15,000 hingga ~10,000 B.G.): Finaies di hutan dalam mula gemar daging, dan badan mereka berubah sedikit, kemudian banyak, apabila mereka menjadi pemburu yang hebat. Yang betina lebih suka jantan yang sasa dan berdaging, jadi mereka mengemudi evolusi ke arah kehilangan antara muka Finaies sepenuhnya. Lishies menjadi spesies baharu.

171588837ff0.en: Greedy Humans Period (~570 to ~680 A.G.): many Wozefaries and Sorefaries spread throughout the kingdoms. Some knew how to grease the wheels to get a good life; others ended up as slaves (see The Greed Period under Humans).
171588837ff0.t: Zaman Manusia Tamak (~570 hingga ~680 A.G.): ramai Wozefaries dan Sorefaries tersebar di seluruh kerajaan. Ada yang tahu cara menyogok untuk mendapat hidup yang baik; yang lain berakhir sebagai hamba (lihat Zaman Ketamakan di bawah Manusia).

182cd4f6ad3e.en: Later on, they made a pact with the Flingas to watch over the south and plan a comeback.
182cd4f6ad3e.t: Kemudian, mereka membuat perjanjian dengan Flinga untuk mengawasi selatan dan merancang kebangkitan semula.

19965731952c.en: ~495 B.G.: humans took over Flatland as the ancient species fled into the desert.
19965731952c.t: ~495 B.G.: manusia mengambil alih Flatland apabila spesies purba lari ke padang pasir.

1a7b2d5e3430.en: Mountain Pact Period (~500 B.G. to ~250 A.G.):
1a7b2d5e3430.t: Zaman Perjanjian Gunung (~500 B.G. hingga ~250 A.G.):

1a868485ea58.en: In this period, they discovered the power of souls and Walking Heart stones and created an endless army with them. One of the humans brought back to life was really good at mineralogy, so his knowledge was extracted, and with it, English names for minerals stuck in the Vraki language: gold, iron, magnesium and so on.
1a868485ea58.t: Dalam zaman ini, mereka menemui kuasa jiwa dan batu Walking Heart dan mencipta tentera tanpa had dengannya. Salah seorang manusia yang dihidupkan semula sangat mahir dalam mineralogi, jadi ilmunya diekstrak, dan dengannya, nama mineral dalam bahasa Inggeris melekat dalam bahasa Vraki: gold, iron, magnesium dan sebagainya.

1c09e211ee4f.en: The Pact (~500 B.G.): seeing how voracious the humans' attacks were, the Fuhraies agreed to a pact with the Buhraies, and from then on their story is intertwined with the Buhraies' (see The Last Breath Time under Buhraies).
1c09e211ee4f.t: Perjanjian (~500 B.G.): melihat betapa rakusnya serangan manusia, Fuhraies bersetuju dengan perjanjian bersama Buhraies, dan sejak itu kisah mereka berjalin dengan kisah Buhraies (lihat Masa Nafas Terakhir di bawah Buhraies).

1e82c76b5508.en: Licking their wounds (mostly emotional) after losing Endlessfog Island to Lishies they thought too dumb to plan anything, they stopped all battles and focused on research.
1e82c76b5508.t: Menjilat luka (kebanyakannya emosi) selepas kehilangan Endlessfog Island kepada Lishies yang mereka sangka terlalu bodoh untuk merancang apa-apa, mereka menghentikan semua pertempuran dan fokus pada penyelidikan.

2002e841c7c2.en: More earth came from where the Lukewarm Buhraies Lake is now. They built an underground structure that pipes its water to Wingarest.
2002e841c7c2.t: Lebih banyak tanah datang dari tempat Lukewarm Buhraies Lake kini berada. Mereka membina struktur bawah tanah yang menyalurkan airnya ke Wingarest.

256c6905e619.en: Fost stones formed during the process, from Soul Energy interfering deep within the land. The Buhraies used them as a light source; the Lishies eventually learned about them, but never used them widely, since fire pits were easier.
256c6905e619.t: Fost stone terbentuk semasa proses itu, daripada Tenaga Jiwa yang mengganggu jauh di dalam tanah. Buhraies menggunakannya sebagai sumber cahaya; Lishies akhirnya tahu tentangnya, tetapi tidak pernah menggunakannya secara meluas, kerana lubang api lebih mudah.

26bbb2f10eaf.en: The Prosperity Treaty Period (680 A.G. to today): the Darfaries, Wozefaries and Sorefaries became equal to humans under the law (see The Prosperity Treaty Period under Humans).
26bbb2f10eaf.t: Zaman Perjanjian Kemakmuran (680 A.G. hingga hari ini): Darfaries, Wozefaries dan Sorefaries menjadi setaraf dengan manusia di sisi undang-undang (lihat Zaman Perjanjian Kemakmuran di bawah Manusia).

26e73987c5b3.en: ~2,100 B.G.: the Lishies found a way to take the island back and began eating the Bruntos as a peculiar food source. But the fog meant they couldn't eat them all, so once they had had their fill, the island was mostly abandoned.
26e73987c5b3.t: ~2,100 B.G.: Lishies menemui cara merampas semula pulau itu dan mula memakan Bruntos sebagai sumber makanan yang pelik. Tetapi kabus bermakna mereka tidak boleh memakan semuanya, jadi setelah kenyang, pulau itu kebanyakannya ditinggalkan.

2920cc2a7ea1.en: The mountain pact was made, along with a new gesture to go with it, the Mountain Greeting: hands up, touching noses (if you can), staring into each other's eyes, and shaking bellies together.
2920cc2a7ea1.t: Perjanjian gunung dibuat, bersama isyarat baharu yang menyertainya, Salam Gunung: tangan ke atas, bersentuhan hidung (kalau boleh), merenung mata satu sama lain, dan menggoyangkan perut bersama.

2a4fa5aa0d02.en: The Hazing of Aldemeri Period (~900 to ~805 B.G.): humans struck back at the Lishies by pitting them against one another. They managed to provoke a war between Lishin and the Buhraies, all while killing Buhraies and sabotaging Bahyum Castle. With the power of the stones, humans worked directly, and indirectly from the shadows, to bring Aldemeri down. ~855 B.G.: the Buhraies unchained the Wood People, which wiped out most humans on the plains, but didn't slow human activity in the southern plains. ~805 B.G.: Aldemeri fell.
2a4fa5aa0d02.t: Zaman Penderaan Aldemeri (~900 hingga ~805 B.G.): manusia membalas serangan Lishies dengan melagakan mereka sesama sendiri. Mereka berjaya mencetuskan perang antara Lishin dan Buhraies, sambil membunuh Buhraies dan mensabotaj Bahyum Castle. Dengan kuasa batu itu, manusia bekerja secara langsung, dan secara tidak langsung dari bayang-bayang, untuk menumbangkan Aldemeri. ~855 B.G.: Buhraies melepaskan Wood People daripada rantai, yang menghapuskan kebanyakan manusia di dataran itu, tetapi tidak memperlahankan aktiviti manusia di dataran selatan. ~805 B.G.: Aldemeri jatuh.

2ad01d13f817.en: Fuhraies: a tall tree-like being with a shaggy blue mane and a root-like lower body.
2ad01d13f817.t: Fuhraies: makhluk tinggi seperti pokok dengan surai biru yang lebat dan bahagian bawah badan seperti akar.

2b02c5ebf4c0.en: The Revolution Period (~50,000 to ~10,000 B.G.): as different groups were exposed to different environments on the southern continent, the land they lived on shaped them into distinct specialized groups. Three new races formed from them: the Fuhraies, the Lishies and the Buhraies. They spread quickly and began clashing with one another over territory.
2b02c5ebf4c0.t: Zaman Revolusi (~50,000 hingga ~10,000 B.G.): apabila kumpulan berbeza terdedah kepada persekitaran berbeza di benua selatan, tanah tempat mereka tinggal membentuk mereka menjadi kumpulan khusus yang berbeza. Tiga bangsa baharu terbentuk daripada mereka: Fuhraies, Lishies dan Buhraies. Mereka tersebar dengan cepat dan mula bertelagah antara satu sama lain kerana wilayah.

2ce1faab243d.en: With Ganyrami fallen, and the desert treacherous and offering few resources, humans slowed their attacks and shifted toward daily life. For a brief time, humans were so spread out that conflicts were rare, and the use of Walking Heart stones faded as times grew peaceful.
2ce1faab243d.t: Dengan Ganyrami jatuh, dan padang pasir berbahaya serta menawarkan sedikit sumber, manusia memperlahankan serangan dan beralih kepada kehidupan harian. Untuk seketika, manusia begitu tersebar sehingga konflik jarang berlaku, dan penggunaan batu Walking Heart pudar apabila zaman menjadi aman.

2d236710a727.en: The Path of No Return Period (~900 to ~500 B.G.):
2d236710a727.t: Zaman Jalan Tanpa Kembali (~900 hingga ~500 B.G.):

2e47846ebd08.en: The history of Vraki, race by race. It starts with the primordial Finaies, who spread across the northern continent and later the south. Over tens of thousands of years their offshoots, the Fuhraies, Lishies and Buhraies, split off and fought over territory. The timeline then follows the Darfaries, Wozefaries and Sorefaries and, finally, the humans. Dates are counted in years before Ganyrami (B.G.) and after it (A.G.).
2e47846ebd08.t: Sejarah Vraki, bangsa demi bangsa. Ia bermula dengan Finaies primordial, yang tersebar di benua utara dan kemudiannya di selatan. Selama puluhan ribu tahun, cabang-cabang mereka, iaitu Fuhraies, Lishies dan Buhraies, berpecah dan berperang merebut wilayah. Garis masa kemudian mengikuti Darfaries, Wozefaries dan Sorefaries dan, akhirnya, manusia. Tarikh dikira dalam tahun sebelum Ganyrami (B.G.) dan selepasnya (A.G.).

3027887b08bb.en: Some tried to figure out why the Buhraies were on the defensive, but found nothing useful. Some Lishies even began to forget the Buhraies and Fuhraies existed.
3027887b08bb.t: Ada yang cuba mengetahui kenapa Buhraies bertahan, tetapi tidak menemui apa-apa yang berguna. Sesetengah Lishies malah mula lupa Buhraies dan Fuhraies wujud.

31853b7e87fb.en: The Devolution Time (~10,000 B.G. to today)
31853b7e87fb.t: Masa Devolusi (~10,000 B.G. hingga hari ini)

31e9064c054d.en: The Landscaping Period (~100,000 to ~50,000 B.G.): self-aware and able to move around, they spread south, conquered the entire continent and shaped the land to look like the north.
31e9064c054d.t: Zaman Pembentukan Landskap (~100,000 hingga ~50,000 B.G.): sedar diri dan mampu bergerak, mereka tersebar ke selatan, menakluki seluruh benua dan membentuk tanah supaya kelihatan seperti di utara.

333e1b6a8d3c.en: The Hifuna Conquer Period (~3,000 to ~2,500 B.G.):

34a611a9d263.en: The Buhraies realized the Wood People and humans had basically taken over the land. They used the last of their strength to cast a spell at the moon itself to make all living things visible, since humans hid, bundled together, at night, but the spell wasn't strong enough and failed.
34a611a9d263.t: Buhraies menyedari Wood People dan manusia pada dasarnya telah menguasai tanah itu. Mereka menggunakan sisa kekuatan untuk melempar jampi ke bulan itu sendiri supaya semua benda hidup kelihatan, kerana manusia bersembunyi, berhimpit-himpit, pada waktu malam, tetapi jampi itu tidak cukup kuat dan gagal.

36eafde28664.en: The remnants of the Buhraies, Lishies and Fuhraies now shared a single mountain and interbred, so more and more Darfaries, Wozefaries and Sorefaries were born, and Vraki became the official language. (The Fuhraies couldn't interbreed with the others, since all the other species are fleshy.) The Buhraies developed the Darfaries interface in this period, trying to control the Darfaries as foot soldiers.
36eafde28664.t: Sisa Buhraies, Lishies dan Fuhraies kini berkongsi satu gunung dan berkahwin campur, jadi semakin ramai Darfaries, Wozefaries dan Sorefaries dilahirkan, dan Vraki menjadi bahasa rasmi. (Fuhraies tidak boleh berkahwin campur dengan yang lain, kerana semua spesies lain berdaging.) Buhraies membangunkan antara muka Darfaries dalam zaman ini, cuba mengawal Darfaries sebagai askar infantri.

3ca713996d24.en: Windless Snow Period (~5,215 to ~3,500 B.G.): a period of peace, with plentiful resources and unoccupied snowy land as far as the eye could see, since the other two races had plenty of land of their own to grow into.
3ca713996d24.t: Zaman Salji Tanpa Angin (~5,215 hingga ~3,500 B.G.): zaman aman, dengan sumber yang melimpah dan tanah bersalji yang tidak berpenghuni sejauh mata memandang, kerana dua bangsa lain ada banyak tanah sendiri untuk berkembang.

43892718a38a.en: The same as the Darfaries': born from the crossbreeding of Lishies and Buhraies on the mountain, then sent flying off the Goodbye Cliff toward Flatland once the Darfaries took over (see Transformation Time under Darfaries).
43892718a38a.t: Sama seperti Darfaries: lahir daripada kacukan Lishies dan Buhraies di gunung, kemudian dilontar terbang dari Goodbye Cliff ke arah Flatland sebaik Darfaries mengambil alih (lihat Masa Transformasi di bawah Darfaries).

43a3004b8416.en: Some human settlements grew into villages, then cities. As the population grew, bandits showed up, so the Sanbi and Tolerideme Kingdoms formed around the mighty adventurers who protected them (not the same as Forway adventurers); at this point, both were cities rather than villages. Roads began to connect these places, including one of the first roads up the Buhraies Plains South Dip into Tolerideme.
43a3004b8416.t: Sesetengah penempatan manusia berkembang menjadi kampung, kemudian bandar. Apabila populasi bertambah, penyamun muncul, jadi Kerajaan Sanbi dan Tolerideme terbentuk di sekeliling pengembara hebat yang melindungi mereka (tidak sama dengan pengembara Forway); pada ketika ini, kedua-duanya bandar dan bukannya kampung. Jalan raya mula menghubungkan tempat-tempat ini, termasuk antara jalan pertama mendaki Buhraies Plains South Dip ke Tolerideme.

4a24e602a5cb.en: The history of Vraki, race by race. It starts with the primordial Finaies, who spread across the northern continent and later the south.
4a24e602a5cb.t: Sejarah Vraki, bangsa demi bangsa. Ia bermula dengan Finaies primordial, yang tersebar di benua utara dan kemudiannya di selatan.

4b08ef99fc63.en: The Buhraies brought several humans to the islands of the Buhraies Plains and taught them Vraki and other research-related skills. They stayed on the middle islands, along with other scientific studies. Buhraies blood was mixed into human blood, letting humans cast spells, some more than others.
4b08ef99fc63.t: Buhraies membawa beberapa manusia ke pulau-pulau Buhraies Plains dan mengajar mereka Vraki serta kemahiran lain berkaitan penyelidikan. Mereka tinggal di pulau-pulau tengah, bersama kajian saintifik lain. Darah Buhraies dicampurkan ke dalam darah manusia, membolehkan manusia melempar jampi, sesetengahnya lebih daripada yang lain.

4ccab7d8b228.en: 572 A.G.: Tolerideme blew up the road up the Buhraies Plains South Dip after losing too many men in the war against Sanbi.
4ccab7d8b228.t: 572 A.G.: Tolerideme meletupkan jalan mendaki Buhraies Plains South Dip selepas kehilangan terlalu ramai lelaki dalam perang menentang Sanbi.

54df17c5ef76.t: Masa Gandew (~270 A.G. hingga hari ini)

59252160795d.en: Lishies & Buhraies Shift Period (~805 B.G. to ~0 A.G.): the children of these species began to crossbreed, but they couldn't breed back with either parent species: these mixed children could only breed with one another, which sped up the rapid growth of the three new species: the Darfaries, the Wozefaries and the Sorefaries.
59252160795d.t: Zaman Peralihan Lishies & Buhraies (~805 B.G. hingga ~0 A.G.): anak-anak spesies ini mula berkahwin campur, tetapi mereka tidak boleh membiak semula dengan mana-mana spesies induk: anak campuran ini hanya boleh membiak sesama mereka, yang mempercepat pertumbuhan pesat tiga spesies baharu: Darfaries, Wozefaries dan Sorefaries.

59b700651583.en: Tribes formed around what they still remembered of themselves on the Buhraies Plains, and in the lower plains too, as villages spread. The Lishies began hunting humans.
59b700651583.t: Puak-puak terbentuk berdasarkan apa yang masih mereka ingat tentang diri mereka di Buhraies Plains, dan di dataran rendah juga, apabila kampung tersebar. Lishies mula memburu manusia.

59e2f04e027a.en: Rumors of ancient species look-alikes began to float around. At the time, the Gandew Kingdom killed any human who wandered too close to the mountain. ~97 A.G.: humans mounted an assault, but the mountain was so well protected that they gave up.
59e2f04e027a.t: Khabar angin tentang makhluk yang mirip spesies purba mula tersebar. Ketika itu, Kerajaan Gandew membunuh mana-mana manusia yang merayau terlalu dekat dengan gunung. ~97 A.G.: manusia melancarkan serangan, tetapi gunung itu begitu terlindung sehingga mereka berputus asa.

5a55fd2e45e7.en: ~2,100 B.G.: they finally lost the island to the Lishies, who had figured out how to deal with the fog, as the Buhraies were no longer as focused on their research there.
5a55fd2e45e7.t: ~2,100 B.G.: mereka akhirnya kehilangan pulau itu kepada Lishies, yang telah tahu cara menangani kabus, kerana Buhraies tidak lagi begitu fokus pada penyelidikan mereka di sana.

5ad561d5fcff.en: They created a common currency, formalized a calendar starting from the year Ganyrami fell (Adrian helped drive both the calendar and the units of measurement), and built other tools to put everyone on the same page and make trade easier.
5ad561d5fcff.t: Mereka mencipta mata wang bersama, memformalkan kalendar bermula dari tahun Ganyrami jatuh (Adrian membantu memacu kedua-dua kalendar dan unit ukuran), dan membina alat lain untuk menyamakan pemahaman semua orang dan memudahkan perdagangan.

5c38bd246335.en: 640 A.G.: an incredibly smart man named Freeish Paulin felt compelled to change things, so he began building a secret base in what is now Forway City to overthrow the kingdoms.
5c38bd246335.t: 640 A.G.: seorang lelaki yang sangat bijak bernama Freeish Paulin rasa terpanggil untuk mengubah keadaan, jadi dia mula membina pangkalan rahsia di tempat yang kini Forway City untuk menggulingkan kerajaan-kerajaan.

5e1316444d98.en: Not as dumb as the Buhraies thought, the Lishies began playing 4D chess: they faked battles with the Buhraies while planning to take over the island.
5e1316444d98.t: Tidak sebodoh yang disangka Buhraies, Lishies mula bermain catur 4D: mereka berpura-pura bertempur dengan Buhraies sambil merancang untuk merampas pulau itu.

5ec9927b2e0d.en: ~5,215 B.G.: the Finaies, having failed to bring down the Buhraies Plains, retreated and created Hifuna.
5ec9927b2e0d.t: ~5,215 B.G.: Finaies, setelah gagal menumbangkan Buhraies Plains, berundur dan mencipta Hifuna.

5f61edf113ea.en: The Prosperity Treaty Period (680 A.G. to today):
5f61edf113ea.t: Zaman Perjanjian Kemakmuran (680 A.G. hingga hari ini):

62a122deaf37.en: They developed a tribal, territorial nature, which forced them to spread out quickly to avoid too much internal conflict. In doing so, they clashed with the Buhraies so often that they got to know the Buhraies' blood Soul Energy and found ways to fight it.
62a122deaf37.t: Mereka membina sifat berpuak dan menjaga wilayah, yang memaksa mereka tersebar dengan cepat untuk mengelak terlalu banyak konflik dalaman. Dengan berbuat demikian, mereka begitu kerap bertelagah dengan Buhraies sehingga mereka mengenali Tenaga Jiwa darah Buhraies dan menemui cara melawannya.

659f004a65c6.en: They kept up constant skirmishes and raids to collect more bodies for an all-out war. ~3,575 B.G.: the Lishies launched a war against the Buhraies, and both sides were decimated as the battle raged on.
659f004a65c6.t: Mereka terus melakukan pertempuran kecil dan serbuan berterusan untuk mengumpul lebih banyak badan bagi perang habis-habisan. ~3,575 B.G.: Lishies melancarkan perang terhadap Buhraies, dan kedua-dua pihak musnah teruk semasa pertempuran berterusan.

67cfa0486fb1.en: The Hazing of Lishin Period (~805 to ~525 B.G.): with Aldemeri out of the picture, humans focused on Lishin, the hub for attacking any other civilization. They failed to trigger another civil war, but managed to start an all-out war between Ganyrami and Lishin, then took over the remnants with a war of their own. ~525 B.G.: Lishin fell.
67cfa0486fb1.t: Zaman Penderaan Lishin (~805 hingga ~525 B.G.): dengan Aldemeri tiada lagi, manusia fokus pada Lishin, hab untuk menyerang mana-mana tamadun lain. Mereka gagal mencetuskan perang saudara lain, tetapi berjaya memulakan perang habis-habisan antara Ganyrami dan Lishin, kemudian mengambil alih sisanya dengan perang mereka sendiri. ~525 B.G.: Lishin jatuh.

68be08773055.en: The Hazing of Ganyrami Period (~525 to 0 B.G.):

696b692d9b1c.en: 570 A.G.: the Kingdom of Tolerideme was winning its war against Sanbi, so it marched on Gandew, and a great war between the three kingdoms began. Flatland became a resting spot for soldiers, especially for exchanging information. The Darfaries were now as flexible as humans in warfare, so it wasn't easy; wars kept coming one after another, mostly ending in stalemates.
696b692d9b1c.t: 570 A.G.: Kerajaan Tolerideme sedang memenangi perangnya menentang Sanbi, jadi ia mara ke Gandew, dan perang besar antara tiga kerajaan bermula. Flatland menjadi tempat rehat askar, terutamanya untuk bertukar maklumat. Darfaries kini sefleksibel manusia dalam peperangan, jadi ia tidak mudah; perang terus datang satu demi satu, kebanyakannya berakhir dengan kebuntuan.

6accfdb2f93f.en: Sundeath Period (~270 to ~380 A.G.): a group of ancient species gathered and created a second mountain, now known as Sundeath. They summoned Naked Bruntos again, but the humans soon rebelled and, with the help of other humans who taught them Vraki and about the world, wiped out the ancient species.
6accfdb2f93f.t: Zaman Sundeath (~270 hingga ~380 A.G.): sekumpulan spesies purba berkumpul dan mencipta gunung kedua, kini dikenali sebagai Sundeath. Mereka menyeru Naked Bruntos lagi, tetapi manusia tidak lama kemudian memberontak dan, dengan bantuan manusia lain yang mengajar mereka Vraki dan tentang dunia, menghapuskan spesies purba.

6b1a8980963a.en: The Replanning Period (~2,500 B.G. to today): they've grown so conservative that they're still planning, or rather, watching what happens in the south and discussing it among themselves as if it were a TV show.
6b1a8980963a.t: Zaman Perancangan Semula (~2,500 B.G. hingga hari ini): mereka menjadi begitu konservatif sehingga mereka masih merancang, atau lebih tepat, menonton apa yang berlaku di selatan dan membincangkannya sesama sendiri seolah-olah ia rancangan TV.

6b9e468317c2.en: Before Ganyrami Time (~2,100 B.G. to 0 A.G.)
6b9e468317c2.t: Masa Sebelum Ganyrami (~2,100 B.G. hingga 0 A.G.)

7472d25f6686.en: ~495 B.G.: they all fled into the desert to build a mountain to protect themselves from what they called a plague of Naked Bruntos.
7472d25f6686.t: ~495 B.G.: mereka semua lari ke padang pasir untuk membina gunung bagi melindungi diri daripada apa yang mereka panggil wabak Naked Bruntos.

7604d58b9061.en: ~500 B.G.: the remnants of the Buhraies and Lishies made a pact with the Fuhraies. The Naked Bruntos' attacks on what is now Flatland kept growing exponentially. The humans couldn't take the land, but the Buhraies drained most of their Soul Energy, and many Lishies died from having all their blood sucked out just to keep fending off the humans. Mortified by the humans' strength, the Fuhraies didn't think twice about going as far west as they could when the Buhraies proposed building a large mountain.
7604d58b9061.t: ~500 B.G.: sisa Buhraies dan Lishies membuat perjanjian dengan Fuhraies. Serangan Naked Bruntos ke atas tempat yang kini Flatland terus meningkat secara eksponen. Manusia tidak dapat merampas tanah itu, tetapi Buhraies menghabiskan sebahagian besar Tenaga Jiwa mereka, dan ramai Lishies mati kerana seluruh darah mereka dihisap hanya untuk terus menangkis manusia. Terkejut dengan kekuatan manusia, Fuhraies tidak berfikir dua kali untuk pergi sejauh mungkin ke barat apabila Buhraies mencadangkan membina gunung besar.

78dc33deecc7.en: Rise of the Flesh Time (~15,000 to ~5,000 B.G.)

78eacb0f1273.en: Blood & Soul Energy Period (~10,000 to ~6,000 B.G.): the Buhraies developed their own blood interface. Their hunger for more power led them to clash with the Finaies to the north and the Lishies to the south at the same time. The constant battling made them flesh out their abilities further, while the Lishies grew resistant to them, ending in a stalemate.
78eacb0f1273.t: Zaman Darah & Tenaga Jiwa (~10,000 hingga ~6,000 B.G.): Buhraies membangunkan antara muka darah mereka sendiri. Kelaparan mereka untuk lebih kuasa membawa mereka bertelagah dengan Finaies di utara dan Lishies di selatan pada masa yang sama. Pertempuran berterusan membuatkan mereka mengasah kebolehan lagi, sementara Lishies menjadi tahan terhadap mereka, berakhir dengan kebuntuan.

7a04caf1f542.en: The Unknown Period (unknown to ~100,000 B.G.): what is known about the Finaies today came about in this period: the ability to move around, sexual reproduction, Soul Energy abilities and so on. They lived north of Hifuna, on the planet's northern continent.
7a04caf1f542.t: Zaman Tidak Diketahui (tidak diketahui hingga ~100,000 B.G.): apa yang diketahui tentang Finaies hari ini muncul dalam zaman ini: kebolehan bergerak, pembiakan seks, kebolehan Tenaga Jiwa dan sebagainya. Mereka tinggal di utara Hifuna, di benua utara planet itu.

8336ed4927b2.en: Isolated Period (~270 to ~570 A.G.): Gandew kept out of human affairs while making use of the Goodbye Cliff. Flatland City came to be in this period. ~375 A.G.: the Gandew Common Duel Rights & Law was established, and it evolved over the years.
8336ed4927b2.t: Zaman Terpencil (~270 hingga ~570 A.G.): Gandew tidak campur tangan dalam hal manusia sambil menggunakan Goodbye Cliff. Flatland City wujud dalam zaman ini. ~375 A.G.: Gandew Common Duel Rights & Law diwujudkan, dan ia berkembang selama bertahun-tahun.

871727959770.en: The Lishies were steadily losing ground to the Naked Bruntos' invasion south and east of the Buhraies Plains.
871727959770.t: Lishies semakin kehilangan wilayah akibat pencerobohan Naked Bruntos di selatan dan timur Buhraies Plains.

875b931a4bf6.en: ~3,150 B.G.: the Finaies launched their biggest strike from the sea. The Buhraies Plains East Dip lost the most land. It was repaired, but by a different generation from the one that built it, so their ratios and practices didn't match the original ones.
875b931a4bf6.t: ~3,150 B.G.: Finaies melancarkan serangan terbesar mereka dari laut. Buhraies Plains East Dip kehilangan tanah paling banyak. Ia dibaiki, tetapi oleh generasi berbeza daripada yang membinanya, jadi nisbah dan amalan mereka tidak sepadan dengan yang asal.

8f0206f4f23b.en: ~1,650 B.G.: Naked Bruntos started to appear, but the Lishies treated them like any other animal: something to hunt for dinner. They tasted great, too, so the Lishies began herding humans and fattening them up like cattle. Unaware of how intelligent humans were, the Lishies let them grow and prosper under their noses, as often as the humans planned their escape.
8f0206f4f23b.t: ~1,650 B.G.: Naked Bruntos mula muncul, tetapi Lishies melayan mereka seperti haiwan lain: sesuatu untuk diburu untuk makan malam. Rasanya pun sedap, jadi Lishies mula menggembala manusia dan menggemukkan mereka seperti lembu. Tidak sedar betapa bijaknya manusia, Lishies membiarkan mereka berkembang dan makmur di depan hidung mereka, sekerap manusia merancang pelarian.

8f96d175e396.en: Population Expansion Period (~0 to ~250 A.G.): the Darfaries and Wozefaries kept growing until they were the largest populations on the mountain. Conflicts between species, especially between the new and the old, rose for lack of space.
8f96d175e396.t: Zaman Pengembangan Populasi (~0 hingga ~250 A.G.): Darfaries dan Wozefaries terus berkembang sehingga menjadi populasi terbesar di gunung itu. Konflik antara spesies, terutamanya antara yang baharu dan yang lama, meningkat kerana kekurangan ruang.

94f88c976209.en: Finaies: two tree-like women with leafy green hair and root-like legs, one reaching out with small seeds.
94f88c976209.t: Finaies: dua wanita seperti pokok dengan rambut hijau berdaun dan kaki seperti akar, seorang menghulurkan biji-biji kecil.

963ef2c9a4bf.en: The kingdoms began competing with each other.
963ef2c9a4bf.t: Kerajaan-kerajaan mula bersaing antara satu sama lain.

984ba7a694c8.en: The Calm Period (~2,100 to ~600 B.G.): the skirmishes between the Fuhraies and the Buhraies and Lishies finally ended, ushering in a period of calm. They shored up their defenses as much as they could, but over time their battle fangs dulled.
984ba7a694c8.t: Zaman Tenang (~2,100 hingga ~600 B.G.): pertempuran kecil antara Fuhraies dengan Buhraies dan Lishies akhirnya berakhir, membawa zaman tenang. Mereka memperkukuh pertahanan sedaya mungkin, tetapi lama-kelamaan taring pertempuran mereka menjadi tumpul.

985ff25eb683.en: They looked for ways off the Buhraies Plains and eventually found the Buhraies Plains East Dip, which was growing unstable. ~1,650 B.G.: they provoked a massive landslide and used it to escape in droves.
985ff25eb683.t: Mereka mencari jalan keluar dari Buhraies Plains dan akhirnya menemui Buhraies Plains East Dip, yang semakin tidak stabil. ~1,650 B.G.: mereka mencetuskan tanah runtuh besar dan menggunakannya untuk melarikan diri beramai-ramai.

9870c3a7d4a3.en: They noticed humans spreading like rats, but didn't care: at least the researchers who mattered truly believed humans were powerless.
9870c3a7d4a3.t: Mereka perasan manusia tersebar seperti tikus, tetapi tidak peduli: sekurang-kurangnya penyelidik yang penting benar-benar percaya manusia tidak berdaya.

9cdf7b22c8a8.en: Sick of the skirmishes, some Fuhraies left Old Fuhrair for the biggest mountain to the north and founded Fuhrair.
9cdf7b22c8a8.t: Muak dengan pertempuran kecil, sesetengah Fuhraies meninggalkan Old Fuhrair ke gunung terbesar di utara dan mengasaskan Fuhrair.

9eec3d0900f7.en: They tried several times to invade by sea, but every attempt was massacred. ~3,150 B.G.: the Great Sea War ended in a massive loss for them, but they at least managed to destroy part of the Buhraies Plains East Dip.
9eec3d0900f7.t: Mereka beberapa kali cuba menyerang melalui laut, tetapi setiap cubaan dibunuh beramai-ramai. ~3,150 B.G.: Perang Laut Besar berakhir dengan kekalahan besar bagi mereka, tetapi sekurang-kurangnya mereka berjaya memusnahkan sebahagian Buhraies Plains East Dip.

9f745374a285.en: With a constant stream of new babies, and the older ones growing up, the bandit leader became the leader of the biggest village in the oasis: Flatland. He poured all his resources into building the village, hoping to use the Wozefaries and Sorefaries as slaves in his mines. Wozefaries and Sorefaries slowly spread through the kingdoms, though many people were racist toward them and most were slaves. Some began changing public opinion by using their abilities and Soul Energy to help.
9f745374a285.t: Dengan aliran bayi baharu yang berterusan, dan yang lebih tua semakin dewasa, ketua penyamun itu menjadi ketua kampung terbesar di oasis itu: Flatland. Dia mencurahkan semua sumbernya untuk membina kampung itu, berharap untuk menggunakan Wozefaries dan Sorefaries sebagai hamba di lombongnya. Wozefaries dan Sorefaries perlahan-lahan tersebar di seluruh kerajaan, walaupun ramai orang bersikap perkauman terhadap mereka dan kebanyakannya hamba. Ada yang mula mengubah pendapat umum dengan menggunakan kebolehan dan Tenaga Jiwa mereka untuk membantu.

a03a0902557c.en: The Lishies clashed with the Buhraies again and discovered how to use Buhraies bodies as a Soul Energy interface to fly up onto the Buhraies Plains, since the plains were far too high to climb, and carving a path always led to a skirmish that took too long.
a03a0902557c.t: Lishies bertelagah dengan Buhraies lagi dan menemui cara menggunakan badan Buhraies sebagai antara muka Tenaga Jiwa untuk terbang ke atas Buhraies Plains, kerana dataran itu terlalu tinggi untuk didaki, dan mengukir laluan sentiasa membawa kepada pertempuran kecil yang terlalu lama.

a0abd79df70f.en: Frustrated that the subjugation of the Lishies had gone nowhere, the Buhraies began targeting the Fuhraies, but that only led to fighting. The Lishies attacked as well, since they didn't know what power the Buhraies were after to turn the tide.
a0abd79df70f.t: Kecewa kerana penaklukan Lishies tidak ke mana, Buhraies mula menyasarkan Fuhraies, tetapi itu hanya membawa kepada pertempuran. Lishies turut menyerang, kerana mereka tidak tahu kuasa apa yang dikejar Buhraies untuk mengubah keadaan.

a8a4c0b61e02.en: The Lishies spread through the forest, especially toward the southwest, where food was abundant. Where there was enough food and strong tribal leadership, their population grew denser and even tamer.
a8a4c0b61e02.t: Lishies tersebar di seluruh hutan, terutamanya ke arah barat daya, di mana makanan melimpah. Di mana ada cukup makanan dan kepimpinan puak yang kuat, populasi mereka menjadi lebih padat malah lebih jinak.

a8ca9bf9cebd.en: Lishin Cattle Period (~1,500 to ~1,000 B.G.): the Lishies bred and fattened humans by the thousands for food, and with so many humans, some were always escaping. The human population exploded all over the lowlands. A small group escaped south and founded what is now Endlessfog and Triangle City.
a8ca9bf9cebd.t: Zaman Ternakan Lishin (~1,500 hingga ~1,000 B.G.): Lishies membiak dan menggemukkan manusia beribu-ribu untuk makanan, dan dengan begitu ramai manusia, sentiasa ada yang melarikan diri. Populasi manusia meletup di seluruh tanah rendah. Sekumpulan kecil lari ke selatan dan mengasaskan tempat yang kini Endlessfog dan Triangle City.

ac84c46b2c5d.en: ~490 A.G.: Old Fuhrair became a mining town.
ac84c46b2c5d.t: ~490 A.G.: Old Fuhrair menjadi pekan perlombongan.

b009a6725fc7.en: ~2,650 B.G.: the Buhraies didn't care about the failed Finaies invasion of the Fuhraies.
b009a6725fc7.t: ~2,650 B.G.: Buhraies tidak peduli tentang pencerobohan Finaies yang gagal ke atas Fuhraies.

b039e6ab43c2.en: The plan succeeded, and the courtroom scientists became the new kings. They wrote the Prosperity Treaty and Forway law so that no more wars over greed would break out.
b039e6ab43c2.t: Rancangan itu berjaya, dan saintis istana menjadi raja baharu. Mereka menulis Perjanjian Kemakmuran dan undang-undang Forway supaya tiada lagi perang kerana ketamakan meletus.

b24ad641d3f9.en: Completely drained of Soul Energy, the Buhraies gave up and fled west, to where Flatland is now. Some Lishies came to the same place, and a war between them left both sides with measly numbers, until a ceasefire. With so few left, the Buhraies made a cooperation pact with the Lishies: they would suck the Lishies' blood to mount an assault to retake their plains. It never worked, since they were always on the defensive for lack of numbers.
b24ad641d3f9.t: Habis kering Tenaga Jiwa, Buhraies berputus asa dan lari ke barat, ke tempat Flatland kini berada. Sesetengah Lishies datang ke tempat yang sama, dan perang antara mereka meninggalkan kedua-dua pihak dengan jumlah yang sangat sedikit, sehingga gencatan senjata. Dengan begitu sedikit yang tinggal, Buhraies membuat perjanjian kerjasama dengan Lishies: mereka akan menghisap darah Lishies untuk melancarkan serangan bagi merampas semula dataran mereka. Ia tidak pernah berjaya, kerana mereka sentiasa bertahan kerana kekurangan jumlah.

b25ffe77fc5e.en: That's when the Naked Bruntos (humans) came about. While testing their war skills, the Buhraies discovered a hunting sport, and especially how tasty human blood was when the humans were frightened and running for their lives. Some also found it tasty when Naked Bruntos were extremely lustful for their tiny beauty. This led to tons of research, and to mixing Buhraies blood into humans.
b25ffe77fc5e.t: Ketika itulah Naked Bruntos (manusia) muncul. Semasa menguji kemahiran perang mereka, Buhraies menemui sukan memburu, dan terutamanya betapa sedapnya darah manusia apabila manusia ketakutan dan berlari menyelamatkan nyawa. Ada juga yang mendapatinya sedap apabila Naked Bruntos sangat bernafsu terhadap kecantikan kecil mereka. Ini membawa kepada berlambak-lambak penyelidikan, dan mencampurkan darah Buhraies ke dalam manusia.

b2c5dbdc4eaf.en: ~0 B.G.: Ganyrami fell. The lower plains and the Buhraies Plains were now under human control.
b2c5dbdc4eaf.t: ~0 B.G.: Ganyrami jatuh. Dataran rendah dan Buhraies Plains kini di bawah kawalan manusia.

b3ea7c798526.en: ~2,650 B.G.: the Finaies mounted a secret assault through the desert to massacre the Fuhraies, but the desert took care of most of them, and the Fuhraies holed up inside their newly created mountain, Fuhrair, and easily defended themselves.
b3ea7c798526.t: ~2,650 B.G.: Finaies melancarkan serangan rahsia melalui padang pasir untuk membunuh Fuhraies beramai-ramai, tetapi padang pasir menguruskan kebanyakan mereka, dan Fuhraies berlindung di dalam gunung yang baru mereka cipta, Fuhrair, dan mudah mempertahankan diri.

b436774afc98.en: ~97 A.G.: they fended off an assault from the Naked Bruntos.
b436774afc98.t: ~97 A.G.: mereka menangkis serangan daripada Naked Bruntos.

b45a2f35b8bd.en: They spent so long planning another comeback that, in the end, they couldn't fix their own mess: Hifuna. They mounted the largest army they could muster, but suffered massive losses crossing it.
b45a2f35b8bd.t: Mereka menghabiskan begitu lama merancang kebangkitan semula yang lain sehingga, akhirnya, mereka tidak dapat membaiki kekacauan mereka sendiri: Hifuna. Mereka mengumpul tentera terbesar yang mampu, tetapi mengalami kerugian besar semasa menyeberanginya.

b46259ebc9cb.en: The Buhraies found themselves in what is now Flatland. Resources were scarce, so the Lishies didn't care for it, but more Lishies arrived as humans toppled their cities, especially after the fall of Aldemeri (~805 B.G.). They interbred, and the first Darfaries, Wozefaries and Sorefaries were born.
b46259ebc9cb.t: Buhraies mendapati diri mereka di tempat yang kini Flatland. Sumber terhad, jadi Lishies tidak berminat dengannya, tetapi lebih ramai Lishies tiba apabila manusia menumbangkan bandar mereka, terutamanya selepas kejatuhan Aldemeri (~805 B.G.). Mereka berkahwin campur, dan Darfaries, Wozefaries dan Sorefaries pertama dilahirkan.

b4ac062d267f.en: ~525 B.G.: a massive war broke out between Ganyrami and Lishin, also provoked by humans after they failed to start another civil war. Lishin fell, and humans picked over the remains.
b4ac062d267f.t: ~525 B.G.: perang besar meletus antara Ganyrami dan Lishin, juga dicetuskan oleh manusia selepas mereka gagal memulakan perang saudara lain. Lishin jatuh, dan manusia mengutip sisanya.

b5758530b037.en: 650 A.G.: the courtroom scientists of Gandew (Asa the Powerful), Tolerideme (Adrian from North Tolerideme) and Sanbi (Bijura Moacir) met at the hidden base to plan the overthrow. They slowly conditioned the people to accept their ideas and stirred up revolts ("the greed of the heroes was controlling the people"), until the kingdoms lost their grip on their people and could no longer wage war on each other. Then the rebellion truly began, and it toppled all three kingdoms. The King of Gandew was executed in front of everyone, calm and relieved despite it all (some people don't believe he was that kind and selfless). The book Prosperity Treaty's Heroes tells this part from another perspective, in Books of Vraki. The King of Tolerideme was starved to death. The King of Sanbi was publicly spanked in humiliation, then dropped alive into the ocean.
b5758530b037.t: 650 A.G.: saintis istana Gandew (Asa the Powerful), Tolerideme (Adrian dari North Tolerideme) dan Sanbi (Bijura Moacir) bertemu di pangkalan rahsia untuk merancang penggulingan. Mereka perlahan-lahan membiasakan rakyat untuk menerima idea mereka dan mencetuskan pemberontakan (“ketamakan para wira sedang mengawal rakyat”), sehingga kerajaan-kerajaan hilang genggaman ke atas rakyat dan tidak lagi boleh berperang antara satu sama lain. Kemudian pemberontakan sebenar bermula, dan ia menumbangkan ketiga-tiga kerajaan. Raja Gandew dihukum mati di depan semua orang, tenang dan lega walaupun begitu (sesetengah orang tidak percaya dia sebaik dan setidak mementingkan diri itu). Buku Prosperity Treaty's Heroes menceritakan bahagian ini dari perspektif lain, dalam Buku-buku Vraki. Raja Tolerideme dibiarkan kebuluran sampai mati. Raja Sanbi dipukul punggung di khalayak ramai sebagai penghinaan, kemudian dijatuhkan hidup-hidup ke dalam laut.

b8478f6617cf.en: Up the Mountain Period (~20,000 to ~10,000 B.G.): the Finaies near the snowy mountains acclimated to the colder regions at higher altitudes and, over time, moved farther toward the peaks. As they did, their bodies changed: their biological rhythm slowed, and they grew calmer, almost as if they were depressed.
b8478f6617cf.t: Zaman Mendaki Gunung (~20,000 hingga ~10,000 B.G.): Finaies berhampiran gunung bersalji menyesuaikan diri dengan kawasan lebih sejuk di altitud lebih tinggi dan, lama-kelamaan, berpindah lebih jauh ke arah puncak. Semasa itu, badan mereka berubah: irama biologi mereka menjadi perlahan, dan mereka menjadi lebih tenang, hampir seolah-olah mereka murung.

b9443a3576a4.en: Small changes started around ~805 B.G., but the new species really began to form and take shape around ~300 to ~200 B.G.
b9443a3576a4.t: Perubahan kecil bermula sekitar ~805 B.G., tetapi spesies baharu itu benar-benar mula terbentuk sekitar ~300 hingga ~200 B.G.

bd2713797352.en: Gridlock Period (~10,000 to ~5,215 B.G.): the Fuhraies now had no trouble fending the Finaies off from their homes, but they were stuck in a deadlock, since they couldn't leave the cold regions anymore: anything above 0 ºC was unbearable for them. ~5,215 B.G.: Hifuna was created, and with it, peace came to the Fuhraies.
bd2713797352.t: Zaman Kebuntuan (~10,000 hingga ~5,215 B.G.): Fuhraies kini tiada masalah menghalau Finaies dari rumah mereka, tetapi mereka tersekat dalam kebuntuan, kerana mereka tidak lagi boleh meninggalkan kawasan sejuk: apa saja melebihi 0 ºC tidak tertanggung bagi mereka. ~5,215 B.G.: Hifuna dicipta, dan bersamanya, keamanan datang kepada Fuhraies.

bd9aff4b8cd1.en: The endless skirmishes slowed and lost their intensity. The Fuhraies assumed they had finally won.
bd9aff4b8cd1.t: Pertempuran kecil yang tidak berkesudahan menjadi perlahan dan hilang intensiti. Fuhraies menyangka mereka akhirnya menang.

bd9fdc47d05b.en: 648 A.G.: Paulin was betrayed and sold to the Gandew Kingdom to be assassinated. But as the King of Gandew learned what Paulin was trying to do, he came to agree with most of it, overthrowing the current kingdoms included, mainly because he realized that otherwise everyone would end up dead and nothing would be solved. He still had to have Paulin killed to save face with the people, but Paulin had given him all his connections, so the king began building a new base in what is now the Freeish Kingdom. He entrusted one of his closest allies (and mistresses) with leading the organization, and made her Courtroom Scientist under the guise of "better war preparations".
bd9fdc47d05b.t: 648 A.G.: Paulin dikhianati dan dijual kepada Kerajaan Gandew untuk dibunuh. Tetapi apabila Raja Gandew mengetahui apa yang cuba dilakukan Paulin, dia akhirnya bersetuju dengan sebahagian besarnya, termasuk menggulingkan kerajaan-kerajaan semasa, terutamanya kerana dia sedar jika tidak semua orang akan mati dan tiada apa yang selesai. Dia masih terpaksa membunuh Paulin untuk menjaga air muka di depan rakyat, tetapi Paulin telah memberinya semua kenalannya, jadi raja itu mula membina pangkalan baharu di tempat yang kini Kerajaan Freeish. Dia mempercayakan salah seorang sekutu terdekatnya (dan perempuan simpanannya) untuk memimpin organisasi itu, dan menjadikannya saintis istana dengan berselindung di sebalik “persiapan perang yang lebih baik”.

bdde2cea62ef.en: The Naked Bruntos Period (~600 to ~500 B.G.): seeing the rage of the Naked Bruntos (humans), and how quickly the other two races were falling, the rest of their civilization fled into Fuhrair and once again beefed up their defenses as much as they could, mostly to hide from the Naked Bruntos.
bdde2cea62ef.t: Zaman Naked Bruntos (~600 hingga ~500 B.G.): melihat kemarahan Naked Bruntos (manusia), dan betapa cepatnya dua bangsa lain jatuh, sisa tamadun mereka lari ke dalam Fuhrair dan sekali lagi memperkukuh pertahanan sedaya mungkin, kebanyakannya untuk bersembunyi daripada Naked Bruntos.

bf5323f8aa98.en: ~2,450 B.G.: the Buhraies discovered the Walking Heart stones, irradiated rocks found in Hifuna.
bf5323f8aa98.t: ~2,450 B.G.: Buhraies menemui batu Walking Heart, batu teradiasi yang ditemui di Hifuna.

c117213fbf5e.en: With the Lishies' overwhelming numbers looming, the Buhraies raised a large section of the plains off the ground, grinding Finaies bodies into the earth, to create a safe zone from the Lishies: the Buhraies Plains, a cliff about 2 km high on average that doesn't erode.
c117213fbf5e.t: Dengan jumlah Lishies yang terlalu ramai mengancam, Buhraies menaikkan sebahagian besar dataran dari tanah, mengisar badan Finaies ke dalam bumi, untuk mencipta zon selamat daripada Lishies: Buhraies Plains, tebing setinggi kira-kira 2 km secara purata yang tidak terhakis.

c7d7101bcef9.en: ~1,650 B.G.: Naked Bruntos made the Buhraies Plains East Dip crumble, and several Wood People fell and slowly began to spread; some became unchained. The Buhraies didn't care: it meant more trouble for the Lishies, and a chance to see how things would work themselves out, since Naked Bruntos couldn't be smart or powerful enough to do any harm in return.
c7d7101bcef9.t: ~1,650 B.G.: Naked Bruntos menyebabkan Buhraies Plains East Dip runtuh, dan beberapa Wood People jatuh dan perlahan-lahan mula tersebar; ada yang terlepas daripada rantainya. Buhraies tidak peduli: itu bermakna lebih banyak masalah untuk Lishies, dan peluang melihat bagaimana keadaan akan selesai sendiri, kerana Naked Bruntos tidak mungkin cukup bijak atau berkuasa untuk membalas dengan apa-apa bahaya.

c7ed0674b31f.en: ~438 B.G.: Nari stones were discovered, helping the fight as a Soul Energy replacement.
c7ed0674b31f.t: ~438 B.G.: batu Nari ditemui, membantu pertempuran sebagai pengganti Tenaga Jiwa.

ca2e3707a447.en: ~338 B.G.: nari gels were discovered, though mostly used to poison enemies rather than to heal.
ca2e3707a447.t: ~338 B.G.: nari gel ditemui, walaupun kebanyakannya digunakan untuk meracun musuh dan bukannya menyembuh.

ca543d7a9984.en: ~855 B.G.: the Buhraies activated their last defense by unchaining the Wood People (removing the Fost stone from the top of each one), but the Wood People mindlessly attacked everyone and everything. Over the years they multiplied rapidly, killing countless humans as they spread, until humans figured out how to use Fost stones to their advantage and built villages surrounded by Wood People.
ca543d7a9984.t: ~855 B.G.: Buhraies mengaktifkan pertahanan terakhir mereka dengan melepaskan Wood People daripada rantai (membuang Fost stone dari atas setiap satu), tetapi Wood People membabi buta menyerang semua orang dan segala-galanya. Selama bertahun-tahun mereka membiak dengan pantas, membunuh manusia yang tidak terkira semasa tersebar, sehingga manusia tahu cara menggunakan Fost stone untuk kelebihan mereka dan membina kampung yang dikelilingi Wood People.

cd4beed3bdd3.en: Eat the Land Period (~10,000 to ~4,500 B.G.):

cdd3216418bc.en: They built their biggest research station ever, Bahyum, and tried to create an automated army factory there, but struggled to control it: it always had a life of its own.
cdd3216418bc.t: Mereka membina stesen penyelidikan terbesar mereka, Bahyum, dan cuba mencipta kilang tentera automatik di sana, tetapi bergelut untuk mengawalnya: ia sentiasa ada fikirannya sendiri.

ce82c8e10039.en: Expulsion Period (~250 to ~270 A.G.): ~250 A.G.: the remaining Buhraies attempted a coup, but it failed. The Lishies tried too, but there were so few of them that the Darfaries easily defended themselves. The Darfaries wiped out every other species on the mountain. Some fled farther west, but all likely met their end.
ce82c8e10039.t: Zaman Pengusiran (~250 hingga ~270 A.G.): ~250 A.G.: sisa Buhraies cuba melakukan rampasan kuasa, tetapi gagal. Lishies juga mencuba, tetapi mereka begitu sedikit sehingga Darfaries mudah mempertahankan diri. Darfaries menghapuskan setiap spesies lain di gunung itu. Ada yang lari lebih jauh ke barat, tetapi semuanya berkemungkinan menemui ajal.

cee81695cb1a.t: Masa Kemakmuran (~270 A.G. hingga hari ini)

cff0487a3a55.en: ~5,215 B.G.: given the extent of their losses, they decided to sacrifice themselves to create a barrier between the northern and southern continents, now known as Hifuna. They spent most of their army creating a curtain of radioactive meteors.
cff0487a3a55.t: ~5,215 B.G.: memandangkan besarnya kerugian mereka, mereka memutuskan untuk mengorbankan diri bagi mencipta penghadang antara benua utara dan selatan, kini dikenali sebagai Hifuna. Mereka menghabiskan sebahagian besar tentera mereka untuk mencipta tirai meteor radioaktif.

d1a138231894.en: ~470 A.G.: a past Sanbi King decided to build a city at the Waterfall, then a small village, as a war measure against Tolerideme: flooding them, which somewhat worked.
d1a138231894.t: ~470 A.G.: seorang Raja Sanbi lampau memutuskan untuk membina bandar di Waterfall, ketika itu kampung kecil, sebagai langkah perang terhadap Tolerideme: membanjiri mereka, yang agak berjaya.

d20adf2eb7c6.en: ~3,150 B.G.: the Finaies launched a massive strike from the sea, but the Lishies were less affected than the Buhraies, since most Lishies lived down south.
d20adf2eb7c6.t: ~3,150 B.G.: Finaies melancarkan serangan besar dari laut, tetapi Lishies kurang terkesan berbanding Buhraies, kerana kebanyakan Lishies tinggal di selatan.

d3268f99d230.en: ~2,650 B.G.: the Buhraies were terraforming Endlessfog right under their noses while the Lishies were busy preparing to fight off the Finaies, in case they were a powerful menace this time.
d3268f99d230.t: ~2,650 B.G.: Buhraies sedang membentuk semula Endlessfog betul-betul di depan hidung mereka sementara Lishies sibuk bersiap untuk menangkis Finaies, sekiranya kali ini mereka ancaman yang kuat.

d7bd6ff955cb.en: ~2,650 B.G.: they mounted a secret assault through the desert to massacre the Fuhraies, but the desert killed off most of the army, and the Fuhraies holed up inside their newly created mountain, Fuhrair, so what was left was easily massacred.
d7bd6ff955cb.t: ~2,650 B.G.: mereka melancarkan serangan rahsia melalui padang pasir untuk membunuh Fuhraies beramai-ramai, tetapi padang pasir membunuh sebahagian besar tentera, dan Fuhraies berlindung di dalam gunung yang baru mereka cipta, Fuhrair, jadi yang tinggal mudah dibunuh beramai-ramai.

d8b6c7033b6d.en: Over time, Flatland grew into the center of the oasis, with many economic activities, such as training Sorefaries as hunting companions.
d8b6c7033b6d.t: Lama-kelamaan, Flatland berkembang menjadi pusat oasis, dengan banyak aktiviti ekonomi, seperti melatih Sorefaries sebagai teman memburu.

dd8c6c4f3990.en: Most were hunted, and some disappeared, never to be seen again. Some fell through the cracks and lived hidden in the forests, away from the Buhraies' fangs, until they could escape. They camouflaged themselves with tree leaves and dirt, and stole food from the Buhraies' homes as they spread like rats. The Buhraies knew about it, but did nothing: they were more curious than anything.
dd8c6c4f3990.t: Kebanyakannya diburu, dan ada yang hilang, tidak dilihat lagi. Ada yang terlepas dan hidup tersembunyi di hutan, jauh dari taring Buhraies, sehingga mereka dapat melarikan diri. Mereka menyamar dengan daun pokok dan tanah, dan mencuri makanan dari rumah Buhraies sambil tersebar seperti tikus. Buhraies tahu tentangnya, tetapi tidak berbuat apa-apa: mereka lebih ingin tahu daripada apa-apa.

ddb02ad4c826.en: 270 to 380 A.G.: humans helped free Sundeath from the ancient species, and it became a refuge from the skirmishes between the human kingdoms. Wozefaries and Sorefaries slowly spread through the kingdoms, though many people were racist toward them and most were slaves; some began changing public opinion by using their abilities and Soul Energy to help.
ddb02ad4c826.t: 270 hingga 380 A.G.: manusia membantu membebaskan Sundeath daripada spesies purba, dan ia menjadi tempat perlindungan daripada pertempuran kecil antara kerajaan manusia. Wozefaries dan Sorefaries perlahan-lahan tersebar di seluruh kerajaan, walaupun ramai orang bersikap perkauman terhadap mereka dan kebanyakannya hamba; ada yang mula mengubah pendapat umum dengan menggunakan kebolehan dan Tenaga Jiwa mereka untuk membantu.

de85a86098f3.en: Since their battle with the Buhraies was a stalemate, the Lishies began fighting, or rather bullying, the Fuhraies too. That also ended in a stalemate, and negotiations never went anywhere either.
de85a86098f3.t: Kerana pertempuran mereka dengan Buhraies buntu, Lishies juga mula melawan, atau lebih tepat membuli, Fuhraies. Itu juga berakhir dengan kebuntuan, dan rundingan pun tidak ke mana.

deb2494ccd95.en: The Prosperity Treaty Period (~680 A.G. to today): the Darfaries, Wozefaries and Sorefaries became equal to humans under the law, but kept some traditions, which was allowed, since each kingdom could have its own laws as long as they obeyed the Prosperity Treaty (see The Prosperity Treaty Period under Humans).
deb2494ccd95.t: Zaman Perjanjian Kemakmuran (~680 A.G. hingga hari ini): Darfaries, Wozefaries dan Sorefaries menjadi setaraf dengan manusia di sisi undang-undang, tetapi mengekalkan beberapa tradisi, yang dibenarkan, kerana setiap kerajaan boleh ada undang-undang sendiri selagi mereka mematuhi Perjanjian Kemakmuran (lihat Zaman Perjanjian Kemakmuran di bawah Manusia).

df3e3e83035b.en: A group of bandits venturing near the desert mountain hole found Wozefaries and Sorefaries dying from falls they couldn't control, predator attacks or starvation. The bandit leader at the time decided to take care of them, to increase his number of Soul Energy–capable people: a move way ahead of his time, since most people would have killed anything that looked like an ancient species.
df3e3e83035b.t: Sekumpulan penyamun yang meneroka berhampiran lubang gunung padang pasir menemui Wozefaries dan Sorefaries yang hampir mati akibat jatuh yang tidak dapat mereka kawal, serangan pemangsa atau kebuluran. Ketua penyamun ketika itu memutuskan untuk menjaga mereka, untuk menambah bilangan orang yang mampu menggunakan Tenaga Jiwa: langkah yang jauh mendahului zamannya, kerana kebanyakan orang akan membunuh apa saja yang kelihatan seperti spesies purba.

e090e3e81c16.en: The Cleansing Period (~10,000 to ~5,215 B.G.): the Finaies back in the north became aware of a disturbance in the natural order of the world, or at least what they deemed natural. They sent scouts, then armies, but to no avail: their offspring's specialization triumphed over their generalist nature.
e090e3e81c16.t: Zaman Pembersihan (~10,000 hingga ~5,215 B.G.): Finaies di utara menyedari gangguan dalam susunan semula jadi dunia, atau sekurang-kurangnya apa yang mereka anggap semula jadi. Mereka menghantar peninjau, kemudian tentera, tetapi sia-sia: pengkhususan zuriat mereka mengatasi sifat serba boleh mereka.

e0f404626a83.en: The sons and daughters of those adventurers were born into lives of luxury and serenity, so they grew greedy for even more, and killing over it was no big deal. Wars between the two kingdoms began; Walking Heart stones came back into use, especially in the armies, and there was carnage everywhere.
e0f404626a83.t: Anak-anak lelaki dan perempuan pengembara itu dilahirkan dalam kehidupan mewah dan tenang, jadi mereka menjadi tamak untuk lebih lagi, dan membunuh kerananya bukan perkara besar. Perang antara dua kerajaan bermula; batu Walking Heart kembali digunakan, terutamanya dalam tentera, dan ada pembunuhan beramai-ramai di mana-mana.

e692bba8dfd4.en: Lishies: a muscular bald woman and man with pale markings, in brown leather and teal wraps.
e692bba8dfd4.t: Lishies: seorang wanita dan lelaki botak berotot dengan tanda pucat, dalam pakaian kulit perang dan balutan hijau kebiruan.

e6d6a7b09e30.en: The Lishies realized the Buhraies were trying to subjugate the Fuhraies, so they tried to kill the Fuhraies off first to prevent it. They seemed stuck in a fruitless battle when they suddenly realized they had lost Endlessfog Island.
e6d6a7b09e30.t: Lishies menyedari Buhraies cuba menakluki Fuhraies, jadi mereka cuba membunuh Fuhraies dahulu untuk mencegahnya. Mereka nampak tersekat dalam pertempuran sia-sia apabila mereka tiba-tiba sedar mereka telah kehilangan Endlessfog Island.

eb9b6c5c158e.en: The Lishies hunted and ate humans so voraciously that humans felt they were going extinct. They reached for anything that could turn the tide, and in 939 B.G. they found it: Walking Heart stones, discovered by stealing information from the Buhraies (see the book Strong Walking Heart in Books of Vraki).
eb9b6c5c158e.t: Lishies memburu dan memakan manusia dengan begitu rakus sehingga manusia rasa mereka akan pupus. Mereka mencapai apa saja yang boleh mengubah keadaan, dan pada 939 B.G. mereka menemuinya: batu Walking Heart, ditemui dengan mencuri maklumat daripada Buhraies (lihat buku Strong Walking Heart dalam Buku-buku Vraki).

ee638c2f8dd2.en: Darfaries: a tall long-haired woman and a tall man in long fur-trimmed robes with scarves.
ee638c2f8dd2.t: Darfaries: seorang wanita tinggi berambut panjang dan seorang lelaki tinggi dalam jubah panjang berbirai bulu dengan selendang.

ef20fffdfd10.en: Summary written by AI from the author's notes (World Timeline.md). AI disclosure
ef20fffdfd10.t: Ringkasan ditulis oleh AI daripada nota pengarang (World Timeline.md). Pendedahan AI

ef37a4bdf4c6.en: As the bandit leader grew old, his children fought for power, along with some old gang members who wanted more for their work. A gang war broke out until most of them were dead. It ended when the remaining members split the riches among themselves and disbanded the bandit gang, by then the size of a militia. Some stayed behind for a more normal life; others traveled far and wide in search of fortune.
ef37a4bdf4c6.t: Apabila ketua penyamun itu semakin tua, anak-anaknya berebut kuasa, bersama beberapa ahli geng lama yang mahukan lebih untuk kerja mereka. Perang geng meletus sehingga kebanyakan mereka mati. Ia berakhir apabila ahli yang tinggal membahagikan kekayaan sesama sendiri dan membubarkan geng penyamun itu, yang ketika itu sebesar militia. Ada yang tinggal untuk hidup lebih normal; yang lain mengembara jauh mencari kekayaan.

ef7b8f2545b3.en: Blood Feast Period (~15,000 to ~10,000 B.G.): the Finaies near what is now Tolerideme began feasting on the blood and bone marrow of fauna and beasts. The variety of blood triggered a mutation in their bodies: the birth of the Buhraies.
ef7b8f2545b3.t: Zaman Pesta Darah (~15,000 hingga ~10,000 B.G.): Finaies berhampiran kawasan yang kini Tolerideme mula berpesta dengan darah dan sumsum tulang fauna dan makhluk buas. Kepelbagaian darah mencetuskan mutasi dalam badan mereka: kelahiran Buhraies.

f0626f0e4732.en: Wingas became their friends and let humans communicate with each other, while Big Wingas were usually dangerous and territorial.
f0626f0e4732.t: Winga menjadi kawan mereka dan membolehkan manusia berkomunikasi antara satu sama lain, manakala Big Winga biasanya berbahaya dan menjaga wilayah.

f12850036462.en: With the Buhraies and Fuhraies on the defensive, the Lishies fought for power among themselves, to the point where several wars broke out between tribes.
f12850036462.t: Dengan Buhraies dan Fuhraies dalam keadaan bertahan, Lishies berebut kuasa sesama sendiri, sampai beberapa perang meletus antara puak.

f14ca1f5ebd6.en: Wild Bruntos Extermination Period (~1,100 to ~900 B.G.): several Lishin tribes set out to eat every wild Brunto in sight, as they realized how many of these "animals" were roaming around. It seemed too late to find every single one, but they were making steady progress, until humans fought back in ways other than physical…
f14ca1f5ebd6.t: Zaman Penghapusan Bruntos Liar (~1,100 hingga ~900 B.G.): beberapa puak Lishin bertekad memakan setiap Brunto liar yang kelihatan, apabila mereka sedar betapa banyak “haiwan” ini berkeliaran. Nampaknya sudah terlambat untuk mencari setiap seekor, tetapi mereka mencapai kemajuan yang mantap, sehingga manusia melawan balik dengan cara selain fizikal…

f258b3856cbd.en: 1039 A.G.: Flingas are seen flying around in winter, something that hasn't happened in quite a while.
f258b3856cbd.t: 1039 A.G.: Flinga dilihat terbang semasa musim sejuk, sesuatu yang sudah agak lama tidak berlaku.

f425b1359d9e.en: ~855 B.G.: Lishin and other tribes attacked the Buhraies, thinking it was the perfect time, but that was false information from the humans.
f425b1359d9e.t: ~855 B.G.: Lishin dan puak lain menyerang Buhraies, menyangka itu masa yang sempurna, tetapi itu maklumat palsu daripada manusia.

f5a292affe89.en: 7 more entries on this page are only in <button class="linklike" data-go-bts>Behind The Scenes</button>.
f5a292affe89.t: 7 lagi entri di halaman ini hanya ada dalam <button class="linklike" data-go-bts>Di Sebalik Tabir</button>.

f6eef97d60e8.en: Realizing the Lishies were focused on the Fuhraies, the Buhraies kept faking an endless skirmish with the Fuhraies to keep the Lishies away from their true plot: terraforming what is now Endlessfog and experimenting with summoning species. Bruntos came about then.
f6eef97d60e8.t: Menyedari Lishies tertumpu pada Fuhraies, Buhraies terus berpura-pura bertempur kecil tanpa henti dengan Fuhraies untuk menjauhkan Lishies daripada komplot sebenar mereka: membentuk semula tempat yang kini Endlessfog dan bereksperimen dengan menyeru spesies. Bruntos muncul ketika itu.

f7d0ddca7dc2.en: 575 A.G.: on a dark, cloudy night, a few people saw someone in robe-like clothing walking drunkenly around Tastyleaf, and a guard saw them head toward the swamp. The guard warned it was dangerous, but the person replied, "I have a literal awesome fucking idea," and kept walking. The Cruros showed up soon after.
f7d0ddca7dc2.t: 575 A.G.: pada suatu malam gelap dan mendung, beberapa orang nampak seseorang berpakaian seperti jubah berjalan terhuyung-hayang seperti mabuk di sekitar Tastyleaf, dan seorang pengawal nampak dia menuju ke paya. Pengawal itu memberi amaran bahawa ia berbahaya, tetapi orang itu menjawab, “Aku ada idea yang betul-betul hebat gila,” dan terus berjalan. Cruro muncul tidak lama kemudian.

f8f417902c6b.en: ~855 B.G.: a coordinated attack from the Lishies and the Naked Bruntos, plus a sudden turn for the worse inside Bahyum Castle (sabotage), put the Buhraies in a pinch. Too stubborn to fight together, they began losing ground to the Naked Bruntos and the Lishies.
f8f417902c6b.t: ~855 B.G.: serangan terselaras daripada Lishies dan Naked Bruntos, ditambah perubahan mendadak ke arah buruk di dalam Bahyum Castle (sabotaj), meletakkan Buhraies dalam keadaan terdesak. Terlalu degil untuk bertempur bersama, mereka mula kehilangan wilayah kepada Naked Bruntos dan Lishies.

fbeb4f4f67ed.en: ~3,150 B.G.: the Finaies invaded by sea, but the Fuhraies were too far away to be affected, as the Buhraies and Lishies killed every invader.
fbeb4f4f67ed.t: ~3,150 B.G.: Finaies menyerang melalui laut, tetapi Fuhraies terlalu jauh untuk terkesan, kerana Buhraies dan Lishies membunuh setiap penceroboh.

fbeea82c2801.en: Fall From Grace Period (~500 B.G. to ~0 A.G.): humans worked their way through countless tribes until Ganyrami, the biggest city of the ancient species, was the species' last stronghold. Amid chaos, infighting and disorganization, humans killed off the entire city: the historic Fall of Ganyrami. The Lishin blood lives on in The Last Breath Time (under Buhraies), and some Lishies might have survived in the southwestern woodland.
fbeea82c2801.t: Zaman Jatuh Martabat (~500 B.G. hingga ~0 A.G.): manusia menyusup melalui puak yang tidak terkira sehingga Ganyrami, bandar terbesar spesies purba, menjadi kubu terakhir spesies itu. Di tengah-tengah kekacauan, pertelagahan dalaman dan kucar-kacir, manusia membunuh seluruh bandar: Kejatuhan Ganyrami yang bersejarah. Darah Lishin terus hidup dalam Masa Nafas Terakhir (di bawah Buhraies), dan sesetengah Lishies mungkin terselamat di kawasan hutan barat daya.

fc77dbf3d976.en: ~570 A.G.: Endlessfog and Triangle City grew with all the people fleeing the wars, and so did what is now the Freeish Kingdom. Blood City grew out of a village full of hunters, and Deltacross grew from the constant flow of people traveling toward Freeish.
fc77dbf3d976.t: ~570 A.G.: Endlessfog dan Triangle City berkembang dengan semua orang yang lari daripada perang, begitu juga tempat yang kini Kerajaan Freeish. Blood City tumbuh daripada kampung yang penuh pemburu, dan Deltacross tumbuh daripada aliran berterusan orang yang mengembara ke arah Freeish.

fe7c4e06281a.en: Sorefaries: three small young people in casual clothes, one in a pink outfit with a red cap.
fe7c4e06281a.t: Sorefaries: tiga orang muda yang kecil dalam pakaian kasual, seorang dalam pakaian merah jambu dengan topi merah.

fef34d1750da.en: Greedy Humans Period (~570 to ~680 A.G.): Tolerideme, winning its war against Sanbi, marched on Gandew in 570 A.G., and a great war between the three kingdoms began. The Darfaries were now as flexible as humans in warfare, so it wasn't easy, and war after war mostly ended in stalemate (see The Greed Period under Humans).
fef34d1750da.t: Zaman Manusia Tamak (~570 hingga ~680 A.G.): Tolerideme, yang memenangi perangnya menentang Sanbi, mara ke Gandew pada 570 A.G., dan perang besar antara tiga kerajaan bermula. Darfaries kini sefleksibel manusia dalam peperangan, jadi ia tidak mudah, dan perang demi perang kebanyakannya berakhir dengan kebuntuan (lihat Zaman Ketamakan di bawah Manusia).
